name: OASIS-1 brain tissue fraction by age
measure: voxels brighter than threshold x robust maximum (99.5th percentile of brain voxels), divided by all voxels in the brain mask
resid_sd_60plus_note: rounded from the fitted value; the spread is wider in older adults, so this value is used from age 60
reference_group: OASIS-1 participants without dementia (CDR 0 or unrated young adults), one scan each
source: Computed 2026-11-12 with ml/paper.py on OASIS-1 (Marcus et al. 2007). Data were provided by OASIS-1: Cross-Sectional: Principal Investigators: D. Marcus, R. Buckner, J. Csernansky, J. Morris; P50 AG05681, P01 AG03991, P01 AG026276, R01 AG021910, P20 MH071616, U24 RR021382.
limits: One scanner, one site, one research cohort. The reference may not transfer to other scanners or populations.
Only valid for scans prepared like OASIS-1 (bias-corrected, skull-stripped, T88 atlas, 1 mm).
Lower brain volume has many causes and is common in healthy ageing; it is not specific to Alzheimer's disease.
